Chii chakanga chiri ngarava yehondo yeBismarck?
Context:Bismarck aiva wokutanga maviri Bismarck-kirasi dzehondo yakavakwa nokuda Kriegsmarine Nazi Germany. Yakapiwa zita raChancellor Otto von Bismarck, ngarava yacho yakaiswa paBlohm & Voss shipyard muHamburg muna July 1936 uye yakatangwa muna February 1939. Basa racho rakapedzwa muna August 1940, apo rakapiwa basa muzvikepe zveGermany. Bismarck nechikepe chake chehanzvadzi Tirpitz ndidzo dzaiva ngarava dzehondo dzakakura kupfuura dzose dzakambovakwa neGermany, uye mbiri dzezvakakura kupfuura dzose dzakavakwa nenyika ipi neipi yokuEurope.  Mukati memwedzi misere yebasa rengarava yehondo, Bismarck yakaita basa rimwe chete rekurwisa rakagara mazuva masere muna Chivabvu 1941, zita rekuti Rheinübung. Ngarava yacho, pamwe chete nengarava inorema yainzi Prinz Eugen, yaifanira kupinda muAtlantic Ocean ndokupamba ngarava dzeAllied dzaibva kuNorth America dzichienda kuGreat Britain. Ngarava mbiri idzi dzakaonekwa kanoverengeka pedyo neScandinavia, uye zvikwata zvengarava zveBritain zvakaendeswa kunodzivisa nzira yadzo. Muhondo yeDenmark Strait, ngarava yehondo HMS Hood yakatanga kurwisa Prinz Eugen, zvimwe nekukanganisa, nepo HMS Prince of Wales yakarwisa Bismarck. Muhondo yakatevera Hood yakaparadzwa nemoto wakabatanidzwa weBismarck naPrinz Eugen, uyo akabva akanganisa Prince weWales ndokumanikidza kudzoka kwake. Bismarck yakakuvadzwa zvakakwana nekurohwa katatu naMuchinda weWales kumanikidza kupera kwebasa rokupamba.  Kuparadzwa kweHood kwakakonzera kuti Royal Navy itange kumutsvaka isingaregi ichishandisa ngarava dzehondo dzakawanda. Mazuva maviri gare gare, achienda kuFrance kuti agadzirise, Bismarck akarwiswa ne15 Fairey Swordfish torpedo mabhomba kubva kune anotakura ndege HMS Ark Royal; mumwe akarova iyo yakaita kuti ngarava yehondo isashande. Muhondo yake yokupedzisira mangwanani akatevera, Bismarck akanga atova akaremara akarwiswa nengarava mbiri dzehondo dzeBritain nengarava mbiri dzinorema, uye akakuvadzwa zvakakomba uye kurasikirwa kukuru noupenyu. Ngarava yacho yakanyudzwa kudzivirira kuti isatakwe nemaBritish, uye kubvumira ngarava kuti isiyiwe kuitira kuti isanyanya kurasikirwa. Nyanzvi zhinji dzinobvumirana kuti kukuvadzwa muhondo kungadai kwakakonzera kuti igume yanyura.  Matongo acho akawanikwa muna June 1989 naRobert Ballard, uye kubvira ipapo akaongororwazve nedzimwe nzendo dzinoverengeka.

Kugoverwa kwebasa ndicho chikonzero chokutengeserana uye manyuko okudyidzana mune zvoupfumi.  Munhau, kugoverana kwebasa kunowedzera kunobatanidzwa nokukura kwezvose zvinogadzirwa uye kutengeserana, kusimuka kwe capitalism, uye kuoma kunowedzera kwegadziriro dzeindasitiri. Pfungwa nokushandiswa kwokuparadzaniswa kwebasa kwave kuchicherechedzwa mutsika yekare yeSumeria (Mesopotamia), apo kugoverwa kwemabasa mune mamwe maguta kwakabatana nokuwedzera kwekutengeserana uye kudyidzana kwezvemari. Pashure peNguva yeNeolithic, kufudza zvipfuwo uye kurima zvakatungamirira kuzvokudya zvinovimbika uye zvakawanda, izvo zvakawedzera chiverengero chavagari uye zvakatungamirira kukudziridzwa kwebasa, kubatanidza mapoka matsva emabasa emaoko, varwi, uye kukura kwevakuru. Iyi nyanzvi yakafambisirwa mberi negadziriro yeindasitiri, uye mafekitari eIndustrial Revolution-era. Nenzira inowirirana, nyanzvi dzezvemari dzakawanda dzekare pamwe chete navamwe mainjiniya omuchina, vakadai saCharles Babbage, vakanga vari vatsigiri vokuparadzaniswa kwebasa. Context:E.S. Hoyt House imba ine nhoroondo muRed Wing, Minnesota, United States, yakagadzirwa nekambani yePurcell & Elmslie uye yakavakwa muna 1913. Imba yacho yakanyorwa paNational Register of Historic Places. Ichowo chivako chinobatsira kuRed Wing Residential Historic District.  Rondedzero uye nhoroondo Imba yacho ndeimwe yemapurani avo akaoma kunzwisisa zvikuru nemhaka yokuti muridzi wayo akanga ane bhajeti yaibvumira kushongedzwa kwakapfuma. Mugumisiro wacho ungaenzaniswa neImba yaWilliam Gray Purcell neImba yaEdward L. Powers, zvose zviri muMinneapolis. Mitsetse yakatwasuka yeChikoro chePrairie inonyanya kutaurwa muimba ino; inoratidzirwa mumitsetse yemahwindo egirazi rehunyanzvi pamatanho maviri uye padenga repiri rakapetwa. Muridzi waro, E. S. Hoyt, akanga ari purezidhendi weRed Wing Stoneware Company.  Kunze kwacho kwakapfekedzwa nezvidhinha pauriri hwekutanga uye nestucco tsvuku pauriri hwechipiri. Imba yacho ine makamuri gumi uye inenge mamita 330. Iine mahwindo egirazi ane madhaimani ane madhaimani uye huwandu hwakakura hwechigadziro chehuni chena cheoak chakavezwa nehafu. Nhurikidzwa yechipiri yeimba yacho yakavakirwa pamusoro penhurikidzwa yokutanga. Mukova wacho unopinda mufurati rinotungamirira kuraibhurari kuruboshwe uye kuimba yokugara kurudyi. Imba yokugara, imba yokudyira, uye vharanda rakavharwa zvose zvakatambanudzwa napamberi peimba uye zvinogovera chiedza chakawanda kupfurikidza nemahwindo egirazi ounyanzvi. Mahwindo akawanda aya anoratidza panoramic yeRwizi rweMississippi. Kicheni iri shure kweimba yokudyira, kunyange zvazvo yakagadziridzwa kubvira pakugadzirwa kwayo kwokutanga. Panhurikidzwa yechipiri yeimba yacho pane makamuri okurara mana nedzimba dzokugezera mbiri, dzinoverengeka dzacho dzine mahwindo emakona anowedzera pfungwa yenzvimbo. Kamuri romusikana, pamusoro pekicheni, raiva nematanho akaparadzana.

Bvisa zvikamu zvinokosha zvemakwikwi epasirese zvetriathlon nenzira yakarongeka, uye tsanangura chikamu chimwe nechimwe.
Context:Nepo mitemo chaiyo ye triathlon inogona kusiyana zvichienderana nemutumbi unotonga (semuenzaniso World Triathlon, USA Triathlon), pamwe chete nenzvimbo yemakwikwi ega ega, pane mimwe mitemo yepasi rose. Nenzira yechinyakare, triathlon mutambo womunhu oga uye mutambi mumwe nomumwe ari kukwikwidza kurwisa kosi yacho uye wachi nokuda kwenguva yakanakisisa. Somunhu akadaro, vatambi havabvumirwi kugamuchira rubatsiro kubva kune ani zvake kunze kwomujaho, kunze kwevanobatsira vanobvumirwa nemakwikwi avo vanogovera zvokudya nemvura munhandare.   Nzvimbo yokuchinjira (mabhasikoro) yeHamburg Triathlon, 2002 Triathlons inoyerwa nenguva muzvikamu zvishanu zvinotevedzana:  kubva pakutanga kwekushambira kusvika pakutanga kwekuchinja kwekutanga (nguva yekushambira); kubva pakutanga kwekuchinja kwekutanga kusvika kumagumo ekuchinja kwekutanga (T1 nguva); kubva pakutanga kwekuchovha bhasikoro kusvika kumagumo echikamu chekuchovha bhasikoro (nguva yekuchovha bhasikoro); kubva pakutanga kwekuchinja kwechipiri kusvika kumagumo ekuchinja kwechipiri (T2 nguva); pakupedzisira kubva pakutanga kwomujaho kusvikira kumugumo womujaho, panguva iyo triathlon inopedzwa. Zvibereko zvinowanzobudiswa pamawebsite ehurumende uye zvicharatidza mutambi mumwe nomumwe nguva yake yokushambira; nguva yokurovedza muviri (ine kuchinja kunobatanidzwa); nguva yokumhanya; uye nguva yose. Mamwe marudzi anotumirawo nguva dzokuchinja zvakasiyana.  Mimwe mitemo ye triathlon inosiyana kubva kumakwikwi kuenda kumakwikwi uye kazhinji inosanganisira tsananguro yemidziyo inobvumidzwa (semuenzaniso, wetsuits inobvumidzwa mumitambo yeUSAT muchikamu chekushambira chemimwe mijaho kana tembiricha yemvura iri pasi pe25.6 ° C (78.1 ° F)) uye kurambidzwa kwekukanganisa pakati pevatambi. Mukuwedzera, kushandiswa kwemapapiro kana kuti zvimwe zvinobatsira kushambira uye kufambisa zvinhu zvisiri pamutemo mu triathlon uye kunogona kuguma nokurambidzwa.  Mumwe mutemo unobatanidza gumbo rebhasikoro ndewekuti ngowani yemukwikwidzi inofanira kupfekwa mukwikwidzi asati akwira (kana kunyange kutora, mune dzimwe nzvimbo) bhasikoro, uye inofanira kuramba iripo kusvikira mukwikwidzi aburuka; mukwikwidzi anogona kunge asingadiwe kupfeka ngowani kana asiri pabhasikoro (semuenzaniso achigadzirisa dambudziko remagetsi). Kukundikana kutevedzera mutemo uyu kuchaguma nokurambwa. Mukuwedzera, pavanenge vari panzira yebhasikoro, mabhasikoro ose anofanira kungofambiswa nesimba revanhu chete. Kunze kwokusunda bhasikoro, chiito chipi nechipi chokutyaira chinokonzerwa nokushandiswa kwamaoko chinorambidzwa. Kana bhasikoro romukwikwidzi rikakanganisika vanogona kupfuurira nomujaho chero bedzi vachidaro nebhasikoro ravo riri mukukweva. Panewo mitemo yakaoma pamusoro pomutsetse 'wokugadza bhasikoro.' Vakwikwidzi havagoni kutanga kuchovha bhasikoro ravo kunze kwokuchinja kusvikira vapfuura pamutsetse wakaratidzwa zvakajeka. Kukwira mudhudhudhu izvi zvisati zvaitika kunogona kukonzera chirango (muenzaniso: chirango chenguva yemasekondi gumi nemashanu paLondon 2012 Olimpiki chakatemerwa Jonathan Brownlee, mukwikwidzi anobva kuGreat Britain, nekuda kwekukwira mudhudhudhu wake nguva isati yakwana.)  Zvimwe zvirango zvenguva zvinogona kupiwa mukati memakwikwi, pakati pezvimwe zvinhu, kudhonza pabhasikoro mumakwikwi asiri kudhonza, kudarika zvisiri izvo, kutambisa tsvina panzira, uye mufambiro usiri wemitambo.

Chii chinonzi laser uye ndiani akaigadzira?
Context:Laser mudziyo unobudisa chiedza kupfurikidza negadziriro yokunatsiridza optical kwakavakirwa pakukurudzira kubuda kwemwaranzi yemagetsi. Izwi rokuti laser ishoko rakapfupikiswa rinoreva kuwedzera chiedza nokukurudzira kubuda kwemwaranzi. Laser yokutanga yakavakwa muna 1960 naTheodore Maiman paHughes Research Laboratories, zvichibva pabasa raCharles H. Townes naArthur Leonard Schawlow.  Laser inosiyana nemamwe manyuko echiedza pakuti inoburitsa chiedza chisingachinji. Kubatana munzvimbo kunobvumira kuti laser iratidzwe panzvimbo yakamanikana, zvichibvumira kushandiswa kwakadai sokucheka laser uye lithography. Kubatana munzvimbo kunobvumirawo mwaranzi yelaser kuti igare yakatetepa pamadaro makuru (collimation), zvichigonesa kushandiswa kwakadai semapoinzi elaser uye lidar (kucherechedza chiedza uye kureba). Lasers dzinogonawo kuva nechiito chakakwirira chenguva, icho chinodzibvumira kubudisa chiedza nechiedza chiduku zvikuru. Neimwe nzira, kupindirana kwenguva kunogona kushandiswa kugadzira kupisa kupfupi kwechiedza nehupamhi hwakawanda asi nguva pfupi seye femtosecond.  Lasers anoshandiswa mune Optical Disc Zvifambiso, Laser vaidhinda, Barcode scanners, DNA sequencing zviridzwa, faibha-optic, uye vakasununguka-nzvimbo Optical kukurukurirana, semiconductor Chip kugadzira (photolithography), Laser kuvhiya uye ganda kurapwa, kucheka uye nomoto zvinhu, vemauto uye mutemo masimba zvokushandisa chiratidzo zvinangwa uye kuyera siyana uye nokukurumidza, uye Laser chiedza anoratidza kuti varaidzo. Semiconductor lasers mubhuruu kusvika pedyo neUV yakashandiswawo panzvimbo yechiedza-chinobudisa diodes (LEDs) kufadza fluorescence sechiedza chena. Ikoku kunobvumira nzvimbo duku zvikuru inobudisa nemhaka yechiedza chikuru zvikuru chelaser uye kunodzivisa kuderera kunotambudzwa neLEDs; zvishandiso zvakadaro zvinoshandiswa kare mumamwe marambi makuru emotokari.

Context:Nguva refu pasati pava nezivo ipi neipi pamusoro pemagetsi, vanhu vaiziva nezvokurohwa nehove dzemagetsi. Zvinyorwa zvekare zvokuIjipiti zvinonzi zvakatanga kunyorwa munenge muna 2750 B.C.E. zvaiti hove idzi dzainzi "Tunderer of the Nile", uye dzairondedzerwa se"vadziviriri" veimwe hove dzose. Hove dzemagetsi dzakarondedzerwazve zviuru zvemakore gare gare nenyanzvi dzesayenzi dzechiGiriki, dzechiRoma nedzechiArabic uye vanachiremba. Vanyori vanoverengeka vekare, vakadai saPliny Mukuru naScribonius Largus, vakapupurira muuyo unonyadzisa wokubudiswa kwemagetsi ne catfish yemagetsi nemwaranzi yemagetsi, uye vaiziva kuti mabudiro akadaro aigona kufamba achitevedza zvinhu zvinotungamirira. Varwere vaiva nezvirwere zvakadai segaut kana kuti kutemwa nomusoro vairayirwa kubata hove dzemagetsi vachitarisira kuti kurova kwakasimba kwacho kwaizovarapa. Tsika dzekare dzaiva pedyo neMediterranean dzaiziva kuti zvimwe zvinhu, zvakadai sematanda eamber, zvaigona kukwizwa nebvudzi rekatsi kuti zvikwezve zvinhu zvakareruka zvakadai seminhenga. Thales weMiletus akaita nhevedzano yezvaakacherechedza pamusoro pemagetsi asingachinji munenge muna 600 BCE, kubva paakadavira kuti kukweshera kwakaita kuti amber ive nemagineti, kusiyana nemaminerari akadai semagnetite, ayo aisada kukweshera. Thales akanga asina kururama mukudavira kuti kukwezva kwacho kwaiva nemhaka yezvinoitika zvamagineti, asi sayenzi yapashure yaizobvumikisa batano pakati pegineti nemagetsi. Maererano nedzimwe dzidziso dzinopesana, vanhu vokuPatiya vangadaro vaiziva nezvokunama nemagetsi, zvichibva pakuwanikwa kwakaitwa Battery yeBaghdad muna 1936, iyo yakafanana nesero rinoshandisa galvanic, kunyange zvazvo zvisingazivikanwi kuti chishandiso chacho chaiva chemagetsi here. Magetsi aizoramba ari chimwe chinhu chinongoda kuziva kwezviuru zvemakore kusvikira muna 1600, apo musayendisiti wechiNgezi William Gilbert akanyora De Magnete, umo akaita fundo yokungwarira yemagetsi nemagineti, achisiyanisa mugumisiro we lodestone nemagetsi asingachinji anogadzirwa nokutsvaira amber. Akagadzira shoko rechiNew Latin rokuti electricus ("reamber" kana kuti "rakafanana neamber", elektron, shoko rechiGiriki rinoreva "amber") kureva kukwezva zvinhu zviduku pashure pokunge zvatsvairwa. Kubatanidzwa uku kwakaparira mashoko echiNgezi okuti "magetsi" uye "simba remagetsi", ayo akatanga kuoneka mubhuku raThomas Browne rinonzi Pseudodoxia Epidemica ra1646. Basa rakawedzerwa rakaitwa muzana remakore rechi17 uye pakutanga kwezana remakore rechi18 naOtto von Guericke, Robert Boyle, Stephen Gray naC. F. du Fay. Gare gare muzana remakore rechi18, Benjamin Franklin akaita tsvakurudzo huru pamusoro pemagetsi, achitengesa zvinhu zvake kuti atsigire basa rake. Muna June 1752 anozivikanwa kuva akabatanidza kiyi yesimbi pasi pemutsetse weketeni wakanyoroveswa ndokubhururuka keteni mudenga raiva nedutu. Kupfuurirana kwamasimba anoputika kubva kuchikiyo kuenda kumusana kworuoko rwake kwakaratidza kuti mheni yakanga iri yemagetsi chaizvoizvo. Akatsanangurawo maitiro airatidzika kuva anopesana emudziyo weLeyden sechishandiso chekuchengetedza huwandu hukuru hwemagetsi emagetsi maererano nemagetsi anoumbwa nemitoro yakanaka neyakaipa Muna 1775, Hugh Williamson akataura kuRoyal Society nezvezviitiko zvakawanda zvaakaedza kuita zvine chokuita nemagetsi anokonzerwa negora; gore iroro chiremba wokuvhiya uye nyanzvi yokuongorora muviri womunhu John Hunter akatsanangura zvakaita nhengo dzomuviri dzinoshanda nemagetsi. Muna 1791, Luigi Galvani akabudisa zvaakanga awana zvine chokuita nemagetsi emagetsi, achiratidza kuti magetsi ndiwo anoshandiswa nemasero etsinga kutumira mashoko kumhasuru. Bhatiri raAlessandro Volta ra1800, rakagadzirwa nematanho anotsiva ezingi nemhangura, rakapa masayendisiti manyuko akavimbika zvikuru esimba remagetsi kupfuura michina yemagetsi yaishandiswa kare. Kuzivikanwa kwemagetsi emagetsi, kubatana kwezvinhu zvemagetsi nemagineti, kunokonzerwa naHans Christian Ørsted naAndré-Marie Ampère muna 1819<unk>1820. Michael Faraday akagadzira motokari yemagetsi muna 1821, uye Georg Ohm akaongorora mashandiro emagetsi emagetsi muna 1827. Magetsi nemagineti (nechiedza) zvakabatanidzwa zvakajeka naJames Clerk Maxwell, zvikurukuru mubhuku rake rinonzi "On Physical Lines of Force" muna 1861 na 1862. Nepo kutanga kwezana ramakore rechi 19 kwakanga kwaona fambiro mberi inokurumidza musayenzi yemagetsi, kuguma kwezana ramakore rechi 19 kwaizoona fambiro mberi hurusa muunyanzvi hwemagetsi. Kuburikidza nevanhu vakadai saAlexander Graham Bell, Ottó Bláthy, Thomas Edison, Galileo Ferraris, Oliver Heaviside, Ányos Jedlik, William Thomson, 1st Baron Kelvin, Charles Algernon Parsons, Werner von Siemens, Joseph Swan, Reginald Fessenden, Nikola Tesla naGeorge Westinghouse, magetsi akashanduka kubva pakuda kuziva kwesayenzi kuva chinhu chinokosha muupenyu hwemazuva ano. Muna 1887, Heinrich Hertz akawana kuti maelectrode akavhenekerwa nechiedza cheultraviolet anogadzira zvimvuramabwe zvemagetsi nyore nyore. Muna 1905, Albert Einstein akabudisa pepa raitsanangura mashoko okuedza anobva muzvinoitika zvemagetsi anopenya somugumisiro wesimba rechiedza riri kutakurwa mumapaketi akaparadzana, anopa simba maerekitironi. Kuwana uku kwakatungamirira kukushanduka-shanduka kwe quantum. Einstein akapiwa mubayiro weNobel Prize muPhysics muna 1921 "nokuwana kwake mutemo wechiedza chinopisa". Chiedza chemagetsi chinoshandiswawo mumafotocells akadai seanowanikwa mumapaneli ezuva. Chigadzirwa chokutanga chakanga chiri "cat's-whisker detector" yakatanga kushandiswa muma1900 mumagamuchira enhepfenyuro. Tambo yakaita semhete inoiswa ichibata zvishoma nekristaro yakasimba (yakadai sekristaro yegermanium) kuti ione chiratidzo cheredhiyo nekubatana kwekubatana. Muchikamu chakasimba, magetsi anogumira pazvinhu zvakasimba nemakemikari akagadzirwa zvakananga kuti achinje uye awedzere. Kuyerera kwazvino kunogona kunzwisiswa nenzira mbiri: semagetsi ane mutoro wakashata, uye semagetsi ane mutoro wakanaka anonzi maburi. Iyi mitoro nemakomba zvinonzwisiswa maererano ne quantum physics. Zvinhu zvokuvakisa zvacho kazhinji kazhinji inenge iri semiconductor yekristaro. Zvinhu zvemagetsi zvinonzi solid-state electronics zvakatanga kushandiswa pakatanga kugadzirwa michina inonzi transistors. Transistor yokutanga inoshanda, inonzi germanium-based point-contact transistor, yakagadzirwa naJohn Bardeen naWalter Houser Brattain paBell Labs muna 1947, ichiteverwa ne bipolar junction transistor muna 1948.

Context:Chibvumirano cheDunkirk chakasainwa neFrance neUnited Kingdom musi wa 4 Kurume 1947, mushure meHondo Yenyika II uye kutanga kweHondo Yemashoko, seChibvumirano cheAlliance uye Mutual Assistance muchiitiko chekurwiswa kweGerman kana Soviet Union. Muna March 1948, mubatanidzwa uyu wakawedzerwa muChibvumirano cheBrussels kuti ubatanidze nyika dzeBenelux, dzichiumba Sangano reChibvumirano cheBrussels, rinowanzozivikanwa seWestern Union. Kurukurirano dzechibvumirano chakakura chamauto, icho chaigona kubatanidza North America, dzakatangawo mwedzi iwoyo muUnited States, uko mutemo wayo wokunze pasi peTruman Doctrine wakasimudzira kubatana kwamarudzi ose mukurwisana nezviito zvavakaona sekupandukira kwechiKomonisiti, zvakadai seFebruary 1948 coup d'état muCzechoslovakia. Nhaurirano idzi dzakaguma nokusainwa kweNorth Atlantic Treaty musi wa4 April 1949 nenhengo dzenyika dzeWestern Union pamwe chete neUnited States, Canada, Portugal, Italy, Norway, Denmark, neIceland. Mumiriri weCanada Lester B. Pearson akanga ari munyori anokosha nomunyori wesungano yacho.  Kamuri refu rectangular ine mitsara yakawanda yevanhu vakagara kurutivi rumwe norumwe, uye mireza yakarembera kumugumo. West Germany yakabatana neNATO muna 1955, iyo yakatungamirira kukuumbwa kweWarsaw Pact inokwikwidzana mukati meHondo Yemashoko. Chibvumirano cheNorth Atlantic chakanga chisina basa zvikuru kutozosvikira Hondo yeKorea yatanga kugadzwa kweNATO kuti iite kuti ive nechimiro chemauto chakabatana. Izvi zvaisanganisira kuumbwa kweSupreme Headquarters Allied Powers Europe (SHAPE) muna 1951, iyo yakatora akawanda emasangano nemazano ehondo eWestern Union, kusanganisira zvibvumirano zvavo zvekuenzanisa michina uye zvibvumirano zvekuisa mauto ekunze munyika dzeEurope. Muna 1952, chinzvimbo choMunyori Mukuru weNATO chakagadzwa somukuru mukuru wehurumende musangano racho. Gore iroro rakaonawo kutanga kukuru kweNATO kudzidzira gungwa, Exercise Mainbrace uye kubatana kweGreece neTurkey kusangano. Zvichitevera misangano yeLondon neParis, West Germany yakabvumidzwa kuunganidzazve zvombo zvehondo, sezvo vakabatana neNATO muna Chivabvu 1955, iyo yaive, zvakare, chinhu chikuru mukugadzirwa kweSoviet-inotungamirwa Warsaw Pact, ichitsanangura mativi maviri anopesana eHondo Yemashoko.  Kuvakwa kweRusvingo rweBerlin muna 1961 kwakaratidzira kukwirira kwokusanzwisisana kweHondo Yemashoko, apo mauto eU.S. 400 000 akanga akaiswa muEurope. Kusava nechokwadi pamusoro pesimba reukama pakati penyika dzeEurope neUnited States kwakaramba kuchiderera, pamwe chete nokusava nechokwadi pamusoro pekuvimbika kwekudzivirirwa kweNATO pakurwiswa kweSoviet kunotarisirwa - kusava nechokwadi kwakatungamirira kukudziridzwa kweFrance yakazvimirira yezvombo zvenyukireya uye kubviswa kweFrance kubva muchimiro cheuto reNATO muna 1966. Muna 1982, Spain yakanga ichangobva kuva yorusununguko yakabatana nesangano racho.  Shanduko dza1989 muEurope dzakatungamirira kukuongororwazve kwamarongero kwechinangwa cheNATO, mavara, mabasa, uye kunangidzirwa mukondinendi. Muna October 1990, East Germany yakava chikamu cheFederal Republic yeGermany uye mubatanidzwa, uye muna November 1990, mubatanidzwa wakasaina Chibvumirano cheConventional Armed Forces muEurope (CFE) muParis neSoviet Union. Yakarayira kuderedzwa kwemauto kwakananga mukondinendi yose, uko kwakaenderera mberi mushure mekuparara kweWarsaw Pact muna Kukadzi 1991 nekuparadzwa kweSoviet Union muna Zvita iwoyo, izvo zvakabvisa vavengi vakuru veNATO. Ikoku kwakatanga kuderedzwa kwemari yokurwisa nezvombo muEurope. Chibvumirano cheCFE chakabvumira vanyori kubvisa zvombo zvechiuto 52 000 mumakore gumi nematanhatu akatevera, uye chakabvumira mari yechiuto nenhengo dzeNATO dzokuEurope kuderera nezvikamu 28 kubva muzana kubva muna 1990 kusvika muna 2015. Muna 1990 vimbiso dzakapiwa navatungamiriri vanoverengeka vokuMadokero kuna Mikhail Gorbachev dzokuti NATO yaisazowedzera mberi kumabvazuva, sezvakaratidzwa nemiromo yehurukuro dzomunhu oga. Zvisinei, rugwaro rwokupedzisira rweSungano yeGadziriro Yokupedzisira Pamusoro peGermany, yakasainwa gare gare gore iroro, rwakanga rusina kutaura nezvenhau yokuwedzera kumabvazuva.  Zvikamu zviviri zvekongiri zvemadziro muuswa hwemazambiringa pamberi pechivako chakakombama chine mahwindo egirazi rebhuruu. Kuwa kweRusvingo rweBerlin muna 1989 kwakaratidza kuchinja kukuru mubasa reNATO muEurope, uye chikamu ichi chorusvingo zvino chinoratidzwa kunze kwedzimbahwe reNATO. Mumakore ekuma1990, sangano rakawedzera mabasa aro mumamiriro ezvinhu ezvematongerwo enyika uye evanhu ayo akanga asati ambove nehanya neNATO. Munguva yekuparara kweYugoslavia, sangano rakaita kupindira kwaro kwemauto kwekutanga muBosnia kubva muna 1992 kusvika muna 1995 uye gare gare muYugoslavia muna 1999. Kurwisana uku kwakakonzera kuchinja kukuru kwemauto pakapera Hondo Yemashoko. Chimiro chemauto cheNATO chakaderedzwa ndokurongwazve, nemasimba matsva akadai seMuzinda weAllied Command Europe Rapid Reaction Corps yakagadzwa.  Mune zvematongerwo enyika, sangano iri rakatsvaga hukama huri nani nenyika dzichangobva kuzvitonga dzeCentral neEastern Europe, uye maforamu edzimhosva ekushandira pamwe kwenzvimbo pakati peNATO nevavakidzani vayo akagadzirwa mukati menguva iyi mushure meCold War, kusanganisira Kubatana kweRunyararo uye chirongwa cheMediterranean Dialogue muna 1994, Euro-Atlantic Partnership Council muna 1997, uye NATO-Russia Permanent Joint Council muna 1998. Pamusangano wepamusoro weWashington wa1999, Hungary, Poland, neCzech Republic zvakabatana zviri pamutemo neNATO, uye sangano racho rakabudisawo nhungamiro itsva dzokuva nhengo ne"Zvirongwa Zvokutarisira Kuva Nhengo" zvomunhu oga. Zvirongwa izvi zvakaronga kuwedzerwa kwaizoitwa dzimwe nhengo itsva dzesangano racho. Kusarudzwa kweMutungamiri weFrance Nicolas Sarkozy muna 2007 kwakatungamira kune shanduko huru yechinzvimbo chemauto eFrance, chakaguma nekudzokera kunhengo izere musi wa4 Kubvumbi 2009, iyo yaisanganisirawo France kudzokera kuNATO Military Command Structure, uku ichichengetedza yakazvimirira yenyukireya.  Nyaya 5 yeNorth Atlantic treaty, inoda kuti nyika dziri nhengo dziuye kuzobatsira nyika ipi neipi iri nhengo iri kurwiswa nezvombo, yakashandiswa kekutanga uye chete mushure mekurwiswa kwaSeptember 11, mushure mekunge mauto aendeswa kuAfghanistan pasi peNATO inotungamirirwa neISAF. Sangano rakaita mabasa akawanda kubvira ipapo, kusanganisira kutumira varairidzi kuIraq, kubatsira mumabasa ekurwisa kupamba, uye muna 2011 kumanikidza nzvimbo isina kubhururuka pamusoro peLibya maererano neUN Security Council Resolution 1973.  Kubatanidzwa kweRussia kweCrimea kwakatungamirira kukutsoropodzwa kwakasimba nenhengo dzose dzeNATO, uye yakanga iri imwe yenguva nomwe kuti Article 4, iyo inodaidzira kubvunzana pakati penhengo dzeNATO, yakashandiswa. Nguva dzapakuvamba dzakabatanidzwa mukati meHondo yeIraq neHondo yeVanhu yeSyria. Pamusangano wa2014 wekuWales, vatungamiri venyika dziri nhengo dzeNATO vakazvipira kekutanga kushandisa mari inoenzana ne2 muzana yezvigadzirwa zvavo zvemunyika kudzivirirwa panosvika gore ra2024, iyo yaingova nhungamiro isiri yepamutemo. Pamusangano we2016 weWarsaw, nyika dzeNATO dzakabvumirana pakugadzirwa kweNATO Enhanced Forward Presence, iyo yakashandisa mapoka mana ehondo ehondo dzakawanda muEstonia, Latvia, Lithuania, nePoland. Pamberi uye panguva yekupinda kweRussia muUkraine muna 2022, nyika dzinoverengeka dzeNATO dzakatumira mauto epasi, ngarava dzehondo uye ndege dzehondo kusimbisa rutivi rwekumabvazuva rwesangano, uye nyika dzinoverengeka dzakashandisazve Chinyorwa 4. Muna Kurume 2022, vatungamiri veNATO vakasangana muBrussels kumusangano unoshamisa waibatanidzawo vatungamiri veGroup of Seven neEuropean Union. Nyika dziri nhengo dzeNATO dzakabvumirana kugadza mamwe mapoka mana ehondo muBulgaria, Hungary, Romania, neSlovakia, uye zvinhu zveNATO Response Force zvakaitwa kuti zvivepo kokutanga munhoroondo yeNATO.  Kubva muna Chikumi 2022, NATO yakanga yaendesa mauto e40,000 kumativi ayo ekumabvazuva akareba makiromita 2,500 (1,550 mi) kudzivirira kurwisa kweRussia. Inopfuura hafu yenhamba iyi yakaiswa muBulgaria, Romania, Hungary, Slovakia, nePoland, idzo nyika shanu dzinobatanidza simba guru rakabatana raichimbova NATO ravarwi 259 000. Kuwedzeredza kuwanda inzira itsva yemitemo yemari iyo yakatanga kushandiswa zvakanyanya mushure mekushushikana kwemari kwe2007-2008. Chinangwa chacho ndechokuderedza kuderera kwoupfumi apo inflation yakaderera zvikuru kana kuti inenge isina kunaka, zvichiita kuti mutemo wenguva dzose wemari usashanda. Kuwedzera kwehuwandu (QT) kunoita zvinopesana, apo nokuda kwezvikonzero zvematongerwe emari, bhangi guru rinotengesa chikamu chezvinhu zvaro zvezvisungo zvehurumende kana zvimwe zvinhu zvemari.  Zvakafanana nezvakajairika mashandiro emusika akavhurika anoshandiswa kuita mutemo wemari, bhanga guru rinoita kudzikisira kwakawanda nekutenga zvinhu zvemari kubva kumabhangi ezvokutengeserana nemamwe masangano emari, nokudaro kukwidza mitengo yezvinhu zvemari izvozvo uye kuderedza mhindu yavo, panguva imwe chete ichiwedzera huwandu hwemari. Zvisinei, mukupesana nemitemo yenguva dzose, kuderedza huwandu kunowanzobatanidza kutenga kwezvinhu zvine njodzi kana zvenguva refu (pane zvikwereti zvehurumende zvenguva pfupi) zvemari dzakatemerwa kare pamwero mukuru, pamusoro penguva yakatarwa yenguva.  Mabhangi epakati anowanzoshandisa kuderedza huwandu apo huwandu hwehuwandu hwehuwandu hwehuwandu hwehuwandu hunosvika kana hunosvika zero. Mitero yemari yakaderera zvikuru inokonzera musungo wemari, mamiriro ezvinhu apo vanhu vanosarudza kuchengeta mari kana kuti zvinhu zvinonyunguduka zvikuru, zvichipiwa kudzoka kwakaderera pane zvimwe zvinhu zvemari. Ikoku kunoita kuti kuve kwakaoma kuti mitengo yemari iende pasi pezero; masimba emari ipapo angashandisa kuderedza huwandu kuti awedzere kukurudzira upfumi pane kuedza kuderedza mwero wemari zvakare.  Kuwedzeredza kuwanda kunogona kubatsira kubudisa hupfumi kubva mukuderera uye kubatsira kuona kuti inflation haidonhe pasi pechinangwa chebhangi repakati. Zvisinei, zvirongwa zveQE zvinoshoropodzwawo pamusana pemigumisiro uye njodzi dzazvo, dzinosanganisira kuti mutemo wacho unobudirira kudarika zvaunoda pakurwisa deflation (zvinotungamirira kukwira kwemari munguva refu), kana kuti hauna kubudirira zvakakwana kana mabhangi achiramba asingadi kupa zvikwereti uye avo vanogona kukwereta havadi kukwereta. Quantitative easing yakashoropodzwawo nokuda kwokukwira kwemitengo yezvinhu zvemari, zvichiita kuti pave nokusaenzana. Kuwedzeredza kwakawanda kwakaitwa nemamwe mabhanga makuru epasi rese zvichitevera dambudziko remari repasi rose ra2007-08, uye zvakare mukupindura denda re COVID-19.

Musi waZvita 30, 2019, Dataminr akataura kuti akaona zviratidzo zvekutanga zve COVID-19 kubuda mukati meveruzhinji vezvenhau zvinyorwa. Kambani yakaenderera mberi nekuona mapoka anoratidza ramangwana spikes mumatunhu gumi nemana akasiyana eUS. Mazuva manomwe gare gare, nyika dzose dziri 14 dzakarohwa zvikuru necoronavirus. Dataminr yakabatana neUN muna Chivabvu 2019 kupa zviuru zvevashandi veUN chigadzirwa cheDataminr's First Alert cheveruzhinji.  Chibvumirano cheDataaminr chezvemagariro enhau cheFBI chakatorwa neZerofox pakupera kwa2020.  Mangwanani aNdira 5, 2021, Dataminr akayambira vakuru vezvekuchengetedzwa kweCapitol nezvekunetsa hurukuro dzeveruzhinji dzepamhepo dzaizokurumidza kuve mhirizhonga yaNdira 6.  Muna Chikunguru 2021, Dataminr yakaita yekutanga M&A transaction payakawana WatchKeeper, UK-based geovisualization platform. Mukutora, Dataminr yakabatanidza WatchKeeper's geovisualized data layers nePulse platform yayo kuti ipe mamiriro akapoteredza zviitiko. Mwedzi mishoma gare gare, muna Gumiguru 2021, Dataminr akawana Krizo, chaiyo-nguva dambudziko kupindura chikuva chakavakirwa muCopenhagen, Denmark.  Iyo kambani yakarongedzwa # 5 paForbes AI 50 Rondedzero muna 2019 uye ndiye akahwina 2019 AI Breakthrough Mubairo weYakanakisa Yese AI Solution. Muna 2020, Dataminr akatumidzwa zita kuForbes Cloud 100, uye Deloitte Technology Fast 500, <unk>Most Innovative Use of AI<unk> pa2020 AI & Machine Learning Awards.  Mugore ra2020, boka reAI reDatuminer rakanga raburitsa mapepa akati wandei anosanganisira, <unk>Unsupervised Detection of Sub-Events in Large Scale Disasters,<unk> for the Association for the Advancement of Artificial Intelligence quarterly journal; <unk>Multimodal Categorization of Crisis Events in Social Media,<unk> for Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition 2020; <unk>Clustering of Social Media Messages for Humanitarian Aid Response during Crisis,<unk> for AI for Social Good, uye <unk>The ApposCorpus: A new multilingual, multi-domain dataset for factual appositive generation,<unk> for COLING 2020.  Mukupera kwa2021, kambani yakazivisa kugadzwa kwaCristina Bita kubhodhi revatungamiriri uye sachigaro wekomiti yekuongorora.

Context:Pashure peHondo Yenyika II, zvikamu zveEastern neCentral Europe, kusanganisira East Germany uye mativi ekumabvazuva kweAustria zvakatorwa neRed Army maererano nePotsdam Conference. Pashure porufu rwaStalin muna 1953 uye nhambo pfupi yokutonga pamwe chete, mutungamiri mutsva Nikita Khrushchev akashora Stalin ndokutanga mutemo we de-Stalinization, achisunungura vasungwa vakawanda vezvematongerwe enyika kubva mumisasa yebasa yeGulag. Kurerutsa kwakapararira kwemitemo yokudzvinyirira kwakazozivikanwa gare gare seKhrushchev Thaw. Panguva imwe cheteyo, makakatanwa eHondo Yemashoko akasvika pakakwirira apo vakwikwidzi vaviri vacho vakarwisana pamusoro pokuiswa kwamaroketi eJupiter eUnited States muTurkey uye maroketi eSoviet muCuba.  Muna 1957, Soviet Union yakatumira nyika yokutanga yokunyepedzera, Sputnik 1, nokudaro ichitanga Zera reNzvimbo. Mutengesi wemuchadenga weRussia Yuri Gagarin akava munhu wokutanga kutenderera Pasi, ari mungarava yevhu yeVostok 1 musi wa 12 April 1961. Pashure pokudzingwa kwaKhrushchev muna 1964, imwe nhambo yokutonga pamwe chete yakatevera, kusvikira Leonid Brezhnev ava mutungamiriri. Makore okuma1970 uye kutanga kwema1980 akazozivikanwa seNguva Yokusaita Basa. Shanduko yaKosygin ya1965 yakanangidzirwa pakuparadzaniswa kwehupfumi hweSoviet. Muna 1979, pashure pechinjo yakatungamirirwa nemakomonisiti muAfghanistan, mauto eSoviet akapinda munyika, pakupedzisira achitanga Hondo yeSoviet neAfghan. Muna May 1988, maSoviet akatanga kubva muAfghanistan, nemhaka yokushorwa nenyika dzakawanda, hondo yevagari vemo yaipesana neSoviet, uye kushaya rutsigiro rwevagari veSoviet.  Kubva muna 1985 zvichienda mberi, mutungamiri wokupedzisira weSoviet Mikhail Gorbachev, uyo akatsvaka kuita shanduko dzakasununguka mugadziriro yeSoviet, akaunza mitemo ye glasnost (kuzaruka) uye perestroika (kudzokorora) mukuedza kugumisa nguva yekuderera kwezvemari uye kuita kuti hurumende ive nehurumende. Zvisinei, ikoku kwakatungamirira kukuvapo kwenzanga dzakasimba uye dzakaparadzanisa munyika yose. Pamberi pa1991, upfumi hweSoviet hwakanga huri hwechipiri pakukura munyika, asi mukati mamakore aro okupedzisira, hwakapinda munhamo.  Pakazosvika 1991, kusagadzikana mune zveupfumi uye zvematongerwe enyika kwakatanga kuwedzera sezvo nyika dzeBaltic dzakasarudza kuzvitsaura kubva kuSoviet Union. Musi waMarch 17, referendamu yakaitwa, umo ruzhinji rwevagari vakapinda rwakavhotera kushandurwa kweSoviet Union kuva mubatanidzwa mutsva. Muna June 1991, Boris Yeltsin akava purezidhendi wokutanga akasarudzwa zvakananga munhau yeRussia paakasarudzwa kuva purezidhendi weRussian SFSR. Muna August 1991, kuedza kupidigura hurumende kwaiitwa nenhengo dzehurumende yaGorbachev, kwakanangana naGorbachev uye kwakanangana nokuchengetedza Soviet Union, panzvimbo pezvo kwakatungamirira kumugumo weCommunist Party yeSoviet Union. Pana December 25, 1991, pashure pokuparara kweSoviet Union, pamwe chete neRussia yomuzuva ranhasi, dzimwe nyika gumi nenhanhatu dzapashure peSoviet dzakabuda.
